caption: Lion Gate, Mycenae
composition: Headless lion relief above the citadel gate · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From the approach outside the citadel, the Lion Gate fills the frame: conglomerate walls, a heavy lintel, and the triangular relief of two headless lions flanking a column, front paws on the altar bases. The afternoon is overcast, cloud cover about 100 percent, about 23.0°C, and dry, so the stone is in soft daylight. The grave circle inside the citadel is not in this view.
alt_text: AI-generated artistic interpretation of the Lion Gate at Mycenae under an overcast afternoon sky, lions without heads
